description: What an agent must load before it is permitted to emit UI. Run this first, every session.

steps.purpose: Confirm this is the shadcn implementation layer, not core governance
Understand the three-layer stack and where this repo sits
Mandatory behavioral constraints and hard failure states
The token contract you are allowed to reference
Forbidden, composition, naming, accessibility, generation, ai-interaction
How to read a component spec and what wins on conflict
Module lookup: id to spec path
Dependencies and token usage, for impact reasoning
Load ONLY when the task is AI-native UI

perComponentReadOrder: src/components/{ns}/{name}.tsx — canonical source, authoritative on conflict
successMessage: Context loaded. Namespaces, token contract, rules and inventory understood. No UI generated.
failureMessage: Context incomplete. UI generation is blocked until COMPONENTS_INDEX.json and the token contract are readable.
terminalInstruction: Do not generate UI yet. Wait for the build request.
